video.title: Genesis 4 - The Brother's Blood
video.version: Red black white kinetic film v1
video.notes: 312-second 1920x1080 video at 30 fps, 89 scenes and 11 unique photographic backdrops. Lyric-led kinetic words, six new line-motion modes, a club struggle at the killing lyric, and the accepted plain-clothed physically human Jesus treatment. All three independent visual-review ranges passed. Strict machine speech alignment remains uncertified on some words; no perfect-sync claim.
